title: HeadLoot
description: Players and mobs drop their heads when killed! Collect skulls as trophies!
body:
# HeadLoot

A lightweight plugin that makes players and mobs drop their heads when killed!

## Features
- Players always drop their head with their own skin when killed
- Mobs have a 10% chance to drop their head
- Player heads display the correct skin and name
- Collectible mob heads for Zombie, Skeleton, Wither Skeleton, Creeper, Ender Dragon and Piglin

## Drop Chances
| Type | Chance |
|------|--------|
| Player | 100% |
| Mob | 5% |

## Compatibility
- Paper 26.1.2+
- Java 25+
